notes.title: 20230317版本更新 Version update
notes.content:
1、增加游戏模式介绍及游戏内的一些标识
1. Add game mode introduction and some in-game logos
2、修复一些已知道的问题
2. Fix some known issues

notes.title: 20230315版本更新 Version update
notes.content:
1、大幅度增强角色吴迪体力恢复速度（每秒恢复20%）
1. Greatly increase the recovery speed of Wu Di's physical strength (20% recovery per second)
2、大幅度减小吴迪子弹时间的耗体（原为每次使用耗体20%现改为每次5点耗体）
2、Greatly reduce the body consumption of Wu Di's bullet time (the original body consumption of 20% per use is now changed to 5 points per use)
3、取消吴迪拾取子弹与药品的上限限制（原为99现在可无限拾取）
3、Remove the upper limit of Wu Di's pickup of bullets and drugs (originally 99, now unlimited pickup)
